# Performance Checklist: G56R-003 Evaluation Runner, Fixtures, Scoring, and Statistical Analysis

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for resource accounting, assigned-attempt performance outcomes, paired and clustered statistical inference, calibration-only analysis-plan freeze, campaign budgets, and safeguards against post-hoc or biased performance decisions.
**Created**: 2026-07-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests requirements quality, not implementation behavior.

## Resource Vector And Assigned Attempts

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec require the raw resource vector to include raw input tokens, cached-input tokens, output tokens, duration, retries, compactions, acceptance, and terminal state before Pareto comparison? [Completeness, Spec FR-018, Plan Statistical Decision Order, Contract score-bundle]
- [x] CHK002 Are failed, timed-out, cancelled, budget-exhausted, and abandoned candidate attempts retained in the assigned-attempt estimand with acceptance zero rather than discarded? [Completeness, Spec FR-020, Spec SC-009, Research Decision 9]
- [x] CHK003 Does the score bundle schema make the required resource vector machine-checkable for accepted and terminal score records? [Measurability, Contract score-bundle resource_vector, Data Model Score Bundle]
- [x] CHK004 Are treatment, infrastructure, evidence-boundary, and candidate terminal failures separated before performance outcomes are interpreted? [Consistency, Spec FR-016, Spec FR-034, Plan Score Failure Code Taxonomy]
- [x] CHK005 Does the decision sequence prevent raw resource comparison until treatment eligibility, deterministic gates, provenance, completeness, floors, and non-inferiority have passed? [Sequencing, Plan Statistical Decision Order, Spec FR-017, Spec FR-018]
- [x] CHK006 Is acceptance treated as an outcome field and not as pre-score treatment proof? [Boundary, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Data Model Execution Trace, Contract score-bundle]
- [x] CHK007 Does deterministic replay require the same terminal decisions from frozen experiment, score, analysis, and decision bundles on a clean checkout? [Measurability, Spec SC-011, Data Model Decision Bundle]

## Pairing, Clustering, And Workload Design

- [x] CHK008 Are candidate and comparator routes bound before execution with role, fixture, task, hashes, capability snapshot, route resolution, experiment policy, and analysis plan? [Completeness, Spec FR-037, Data Model Comparison Set and Assignment]
- [x] CHK009 Are later refreshes required to create additive invalidations rather than rebinding existing pairs? [Boundary, Spec FR-037, Plan Versioning and Additive Invalidation]
- [x] CHK010 Does the spec require task-paired non-inferiority instead of independent per-arm or unpaired comparisons? [Completeness, Spec FR-018, Spec SC-007]
- [x] CHK011 Does the data model require cluster unit or correlation handling for repeated role/fixture observations? [Measurability, Data Model Analysis Plan, Research Decision 8]
- [x] CHK012 Is cluster-adjusted non-inferiority required before any resource-vector dominance claim? [Sequencing, Spec FR-018, Plan Statistical Decision Order]
- [x] CHK013 Do the spec and plan require frozen workload strata, including p95 or other tail-latency guardrails, so average-only duration claims cannot satisfy the performance decision rule? [Completeness, Spec FR-018, Spec FR-038, Plan Slice 3, Plan Statistical Decision Order]
- [x] CHK014 Are workload and routing comparisons scoped to the governed corpus and immutable pair bindings instead of ad hoc candidate samples? [Coverage, Spec FR-011, Spec FR-037, Plan Slice 3]

## Analysis Plan And Statistical Controls

- [x] CHK015 Does calibration estimate feasibility, variance, missingness, scorer behavior, and sample-size inputs without qualifying routes? [Boundary, Spec Clarifications Session 4, Research Decision 10]
- [x] CHK016 Is the freeze point after calibration and before any G56R-007 through G56R-010 outcome-bearing evidence? [Sequencing, Spec FR-023, Spec FR-038, Spec SC-012]
- [x] CHK017 Does the frozen plan include sample sizes, power, alpha, multiplicity, racing, futility, attrition caps, rerun limits, budgets, terminal rules, and inconclusive handling? [Completeness, Spec FR-038, Data Model Analysis Plan]
- [x] CHK018 Is the analysis plan itself required as a schema-governed contract artifact rather than only an ID/digest binding or prose data-model entity? [Measurability, Spec FR-038, Plan Source Ownership, Plan Project Structure, Data Model Analysis Plan]
- [x] CHK019 Are multiplicity controls required before making multiple route or metric conclusions from the same campaign evidence? [Measurability, Spec FR-038, Research Decision 8, FDA Multiple Endpoints guidance]
- [x] CHK020 Is non-inferiority based on prespecified margins and confidence bounds rather than nonsignificant superiority tests? [Clarity, Plan Statistical Decision Order, Research Decision 8, CONSORT Non-inferiority guidance]
- [x] CHK021 Are attrition and incomplete evidence handled by the assigned-attempt estimand and inconclusive/no-qualification states rather than complete-case analysis? [Coverage, Spec FR-020, Spec FR-021, Research Decision 9]
- [x] CHK022 Does the decision bundle surface ordered gate results so a replay can prove which statistical step stopped the decision? [Traceability, Contract analysis-decision, Data Model Decision Bundle]

## Campaign Budgets And Execution Boundaries

- [x] CHK023 Does the spec require live campaigns to be explicit, local, pinned, and budgeted, while default CI runs deterministic replay only? [Boundary, Spec FR-022, Research Decision 11]
- [x] CHK024 Does the experiment policy schema require attempt, duration, input-token, and output-token ceilings before live execution? [Measurability, Contract experiment-policy budget]
- [x] CHK025 Are cached-input token ceilings, candidate-count ceilings, and confirmation-entry caps explicitly required alongside raw token and time budgets? [Completeness, Spec FR-022, Plan Slice 3, Plan Statistical Decision Order]
- [x] CHK026 Is budget exhaustion a terminal assigned outcome, not an excuse to discard or retry a candidate arm? [Boundary, Spec FR-020, Contract score-bundle terminal_state, Research Decision 9]
- [x] CHK027 Are capped complete-pair reruns allowed only for independently preclassified transient harness failures? [Measurability, Spec FR-021, Contract experiment-policy rerun_policy]
- [x] CHK028 Are one-arm reruns prohibited clearly enough to protect pairing and attrition comparability? [Boundary, Spec FR-021, Spec SC-010, Research Decision 9]

## Bias, Leakage, And Ranking Safeguards

- [x] CHK029 Are post-hoc thresholds prevented by freezing numeric margins, sample sizes, power, alpha, multiplicity, racing/futility, attrition, budgets, and terminal rules before cohort outcomes? [Boundary, Spec FR-038, Research Decision 10]
- [x] CHK030 Are unpaired comparisons rejected through immutable task-level pair assignment and paired non-inferiority requirements? [Coverage, Spec FR-018, Spec FR-037]
- [x] CHK031 Are candidate-caused failures and missing terminal outcomes prevented from becoming complete-case exclusions? [Coverage, Spec FR-020, Spec FR-021]
- [x] CHK032 Does the spec require cache isolation or a frozen cache policy so cached-input token measurements cannot leak treatment order, prior candidate work, or shared prompt state into resource comparisons? [Completeness, Spec FR-018, Spec FR-038, Plan Slice 3, Plan Statistical Decision Order]
- [x] CHK033 Does the spec prohibit hidden weighted scores and forced rankings by using unweighted raw-vector Pareto dominance after quality gates? [Boundary, Spec FR-019, Research Decision 8, Design Concept Q7]
- [x] CHK034 Are ties, mixed dominance, incomplete evidence, failed gates, and statistical uncertainty required to produce no qualification rather than a route ordering? [Coverage, Spec FR-019, Plan Statistical Decision Order]

## Notes

- First pass found four performance requirement-quality gaps: workload strata and p95 guardrails; schema-governed analysis-plan contract; cached-input/candidate/confirmation-entry campaign budgets; and cache-isolation policy for resource comparisons.
- Second pass found all four gaps closed by targeted spec and plan remediation.
